micropython.globals:
from machine import Pin, PWM
import time

led_r_${COMP_SUFFIX} = PWM(Pin(${R}))
led_g_${COMP_SUFFIX} = PWM(Pin(${G}))
led_b_${COMP_SUFFIX} = PWM(Pin(${B}))
led_r_${COMP_SUFFIX}.freq(1000)
led_g_${COMP_SUFFIX}.freq(1000)
led_b_${COMP_SUFFIX}.freq(1000)
micropython.loop:
# Red
led_r_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(65535)
led_g_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
led_b_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Green
led_r_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
led_g_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(65535)
led_b_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Blue
led_r_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
led_g_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(0)
led_b_${COMP_SUFFIX}.duty_u16(65535)
time.sleep(0.5)
